data.rule: Dry spell: rain in the last 14 days and root-zone soil wetness are both at or below the 20th percentile for this time of year. Watch: either one is at or below the 30th percentile. Without soil data, low rain gives at most Watch. Cut-offs follow the U.S. Drought Monitor's percentile bands (D0 = 21st–30th, D1 = 11th–20th); they are demonstration settings, not agronomic standards. Water balance and the Kansas drought outlook are shown as context and do not change the status. Rule version 2.
